question: Which athlete won the Arjuna Award for athletics in January 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jyothi Yarraji**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Jyothi Yarraji** is an Indian track and field athlete specializing in **hurdling events**. She has emerged as one of the leading athletes in her domain in recent years.
 
• She is the first Indian woman to break the **13-second barrier** in the 100m hurdles, establishing herself as a standout performer on the national and international stage.
 
• In **January 2025**, Jyothi Yarraji was awarded the prestigious **Arjuna Award** for her contributions to athletics, recognizing her achievements and dedication to sports in India.
 
• The **Arjuna Award**, instituted in **1961**, is one of the highest civilian awards for sports in India, honoring outstanding performance and contributions in sports.
 
• Jyothi’s consistent performance in **national and international competitions**, coupled with her ability to set new benchmarks in hurdling, made her a deserving candidate for this accolade.
